text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
âAh, I knew it!
Hello, Journey-san!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...Buena-san.
It's rare to run into you in a place like this.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I caught a whiff of Journey-san's scent while walking!
I thought it might be her, so I followed it.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, oh? There's... nothing here, is there?
What are you doing in a place like this—

text_block_list.name: Stern-Looking Man
text_block_list.text:
—Journey-san.
Who might that be?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Hello, mister!
Nice to meet you, I'm Buena Vista.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: You were meeting someone! Sorry for interrupting.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: I see! So that gentleman was the owner of this place.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: But... was it really alright for me to tag along too? You had... an important matter to discuss, right?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"I don't mind.
I was just one move away from checkmate anyway."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Actually... I'm in the middle of asking
if they could display my mother's illustrations here.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Your mother is an illustrator, right?
To have her work displayed in such a popular café...
That's truly amazing!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
However... the adjustments are running into a bit of trouble.
We haven't pinned down the general framework for what kind of illustration to go with.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
It was quite a difficult negotiation, but...
today, I feel we can finally find a way forward—

text_block_list.name: Stern-Looking Man
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for waiting.
Now, please show me the rough draft.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"—Here is the newly drawn rough draft
based on our previous meeting."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Wah...!
Amazing, it's so cute...!

text_block_list.name: Stern-Looking Man
text_block_list.text:
...—
Did you... take a liking to it?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Yes, very much so! Is she a princess, perhaps?
It looks like an illustration from a picture book, so lovely...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Her golden hair fluttering in the wind... it's so magical.
What a breathtaking view...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Wait, my apologies!
There's no point in me rambling on, is there?

text_block_list.name: Stern-Looking Man
text_block_list.text:
"...No. I share her opinion.
Please proceed with that plan."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it'll definitely suit the shop♪
Once you put it on display, please let me come see it!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, both of you.
Well then, allow me to proceed.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Our innocent young lady
will surely be delighted as well.

text_block_list.name: Stern-Looking Man
text_block_list.text:
—!
Why would you—

text_block_list.name: Stern-Looking Man
text_block_list.text:
"...No, you're right.
I hope so, too—"

One day, when I went to the cafeteria...
Dream Journey and Buena Vista were talking
in front of an illustration.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Waah, so very cute...!
May I really have such a wonderful illustration?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Of course. Thank you so much...
for everything the other day.
choice_data_list: You two really get along well, don't you?
You two really get along well, huh?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Of course. Thank you so much...
for everything the other day.
choice_data_list: You two really get along well, don't you?
You two really get along well, huh?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
No, no, it's nothing! It's just, out of nowhere,
I received a drawing of Mother.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Journey-san is really
so very kind, isn't she!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, I'm sorry.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, does it look that way?
I really respect Journey-san, so... that makes me happy!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
So, I would be even happier if we could
become closer friends... What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
The pleasure is mine. I would love to be friends.
After all... I am quite fond of you too.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, I'm sorry.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Oh, Mother. ...Ah, regarding the other day... Is that so? I'm glad to hear it was well-received.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
No, all I did was negotiate.
The job offers increased because of your charm.
Your illustrations are truly wonderful, Mother.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
An innocent heart
has the power to move people, after all—
